What is actually for sale?

ItemWhat it does
Four outfitsChanges the courier in Hideout, campaign, weekly runs and share cards. All have the same gameplay stats.
Escape trail · 200 creditsMint light follows a moving courier carrying the phone. Cosmetic only. Disabled when reduced effects is enabled.
Courier Frame / Vault FinishRemoved from new sales. Their old implementation was too minor to justify the store space. Previous ownership is preserved.
PhonesA collection from completed missions, not another purchase.

Credits and Phantom

BROWSER DEMO Opening the credits screen does not add credits. Choosing a pack then confirming “Add demo credits” adds local test currency. This does not open Phantom or spend money.

ANDROID The native checkout uses Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter. Choose SKR or SOL, approve in your wallet, and the backend verifies the payment before adding credits. Retrying the same receipt cannot credit the pack twice. A new physical-phone payment was not performed during this audit.

Verification

Checked Frost Runner in campaign and weekly practice. Checked the store at 390×844 and 360×640. Automated purchase tests cover quote creation, verified fulfillment, duplicate receipts, ownership and retiring the two items. Updated the existing Railway API; its health and catalog endpoints passed.

The share-card preview uses sample stats. In the game, the same layout receives the wallet’s current weekly data and equipped outfit.
